name: The Pack Corporation
summary: The Pack Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells paper products, film packaging, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company offers tote bags, paper bags, plastic bags, parcel delivery bags, sewn bags, garment bags, and other bags; paper boxes, paper trays, clear cases, and other types of boxes in various shapes; and corrugated shipping boxes, large-corrugated boxes for packing major appliances, and cushioning materials.
